description: The Turmhof at Steckborn stands directly on the Untersee, a medieval tower house with a round stair turret and a baroque roof cap, beside half-timbered houses along the promenade. The water is the lower arm of Lake Constance, and the far shore is low. The lakeside tower is the subject of this Thurgau town. The Open-Meteo model is fully overcast and breezy, with no rain.
